Name: Dynamic Wind and Shadows Sway - Universal Procedural Animation
Author: houlvex
Description:
OVERVIEW
Give Stardew Valley a modern, living atmosphere! Dynamic Wind & Shadows Sway uses real-time C# procedural physics (via Harmony) to gently animate trees, bushes, and grass in unison with the breeze—including their ground shadows!

Unlike traditional frame-by-frame Content Patcher animations, this mod moves sprites mathematically at a silky-smooth 60 FPS without modifying any image files.

KEY FEATURES
- 100% Universal Compatibility: Works automatically with ALL custom trees, bushes, recolors, and expansion mods (Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village, etc.) out of the box!
- Dynamic Moving Shadows: Tree and bush shadows stretch and shift smoothly on the ground in sync with the canopy sway.
- Weight-Based Wind Physics: Small grass and saplings sway flexibly, while massive full-grown trees move with heavy, realistic resistance.
- Synchronized Wind Waves: All foliage moves harmoniously in the same wind direction.
- Live Weather Reaction: Wind speed and sway intensity automatically pick up during rainy, windy, and stormy/lightning days!
- Zero Dependencies: Only requires SMAPI. Lightweight with zero FPS drop.

[b]INSTALLATION[/b]
1. Install the latest version of SMAPI.
2. Download this mod and unzip it into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
3. Run the game using SMAPI!
